text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: runtime.regression detected for service 'inference-runtime' in us-west-2. Alert: p99 /v1/generate spiked ~900ms -> 1.1s, error rate +2.8%. Paging oncall.
Maya R: saw it, pinging oncall. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/inference/us-west-2/alerts/1758204567
Samir: I'm oncall, grabbing logs and recent deploys. Any deploys in the last 20m?
Jess K: I promoted hotpatch v2.3.4 to 30% in us-west-2 ~12m ago to address a small memory leak.
Lee Chen: looking at runtime logs — a bunch of kernel selection fallbacks to int8-quant and microbatch buffer growth. Might be a routing/quantization mismatch.
Samir: can you paste a sample log line?
Lee Chen: ```
2025-11-10T12:34:02Z ERROR kernel_select: fallback_to_quant kernel=int8-quant seq_len=128 batch=1 node=rt-24 rt_ms=980 cache_miss=true
2025-11-10T12:34:05Z WARN  batcher: microbatch_buffer_size=64 queue_wait_ms=430
```
Samir: that's consistent with the latency spike. Jess, your rollout touched the routing config for quantized kernels?
Jess K: yes — v2.3.4 enabled quant-routing to prefer smaller kernels for cost. It rolled to us-west-2 30% traffic.
Paul D: hypothesis: quant-routing heuristic misclassified many short-seq requests, forcing fallback and blowing up per-token overhead.
Samir: OK. Action: pause rollout + disable quant-routing in us-west-2. Executing: `redwoodctl feature toggle quant-routing --env=us-west-2 --off`
Maya R: Jess, can you pause the rollout in the console too?
Jess K: done — scaled hotpatch v2.3.4 from 30% -> 0% in us-west-2. No further promotions.
Incident Bot: automation: rollout hotpatch-v2.3.4 scaled to 0% by Jess K at 12:36:15Z.
Caroline: Support triage: initial customer impact — 12 tenants reported timeouts/slow responses. Top affected: acme-inc, bluehome, noteapp. We have 7 open tickets so far.
Support Bot: updating status.redwood.com with a " degraded performance " note.
Lee Chen: digging deeper, kernel affinity map generator produced a bad mapping for slice-size=8 jobs; fallback to int8-quant triggers heavy GEMM path due to missing fused kernels, causing high tail latency.
Paul D: can we flip a mitigation flag to force legacy kernel selection for affected nodes while we patch the generator?
Samir: running `redwoodctl node-config set kernel_affinity_override=legacy --selector=us-west-2 && redwoodctl cache flush kv-cache --region=us-west-2`
Samir: executed commands, monitoring metrics.
Maya R: monitoring p99 and error rate.
Samir: p99 trending down — 1.1s -> 210ms over next 3 minutes. Error rate also dropping.
Caroline: support update: informed customers of mitigation and ETA for a permanent fix.
Jess K: I'm halting any further feature rollouts until patch and canary verification complete.
Lee Chen: created a small rollback PR for the affinity generator and a test that simulates short-seq microbatches. Will prepare patch for review now.
Paul D: we'll add an automated canary check for kernel fallback events before future rollouts.
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Alert cleared: p99 returned to baseline at 12:42:10Z.
Samir: closing the pager; will file an incident writeup + RCA. Follow-ups: (1) revert quant-routing change until verified, (2) patch affinity generator, (3) add canary kernel-fallback alert and gate.
Maya R: thanks team — please add customer-impact summary to the follow-up and tag SRE and Support.
Support Bot: customer notifications queued to go out with status update and ticket follow-ups.
Samir: incident closed from oncall. Will hand over the doc to Maya for postmortem and action tracking.``
